tips.body: Remnant of the Wheel (×26) comes from a new 3.7 weekly boss, capped at 3 claims per week account-wide — so a fully maxed forte tree takes roughly 9 weeks from launch even if you start day one. She shares this drop with Hsin: if you're building both, plan for the claims to stretch across ~18 weeks, or pick one to max first.
tips.heading: Start with the weekly-boss math

tips.body: Fallen Sanctum (Forgery Challenge, Etching Plains) drops all four Wing Polarizer tiers in one place. Run the highest difficulty your Union Level allows — higher tiers weight drops toward Polywing and Layered Wing, which are the ones you'll run short on (55 and 67 needed).
tips.heading: Farm polarizers first — they're live now

tips.body: Early pre-farm lists guessed Autopuppet Kernel because she's a Mengzhou Resonator, but her farming card shows Howler Cores — the oldest core family in the game. You need 29 LF, 40 MF, 52 HF and 61 FF across ascension and forte. Trade up 3-to-1 at the Synthesizer rather than over-farming low tiers.
tips.heading: Howler Cores, not Autopuppet Kernels

tips.body: Forged Empyrean's Sigh (×46) drops from Calamity Effigy at Verdant Court, on the western side of Xuanfang Hold. It unlocks through Chapter 4 Act III (the quest 'Song of the Heart Sword') — or open the Guidebook and use Boss Challenge early access if your story progress is behind. Don't start farming without the boss unlocked.
tips.heading: Unlock the boss first

tips.body: Her local specialty (×60) lives in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou — 48 per sweep from 6 clusters of red-aura tree remains (NW beacon riverside → SE lakeshore → NE shore → Heartscape Labyrinth → Repair Workshop arena → N of Heart of Bloom), plus 15 at the Huaxu Apothecary for 45,000 Shell Credits. Specialties respawn daily, so one sweep plus the shop covers all 60.
tips.heading: Miasmic Branch farming route

tips.body: 170,000 for ascension plus 2,030,000 for the full forte tree. (Add ~330,000 more if you're also leveling her signature sword Unspoken Rue.) Start banking credits now — this is the easiest thing to fall behind on.
tips.heading: Budget 2.2M Shell Credits

tips.body: Lynae debuted in 3.0, so nothing on her list is time-gated — you can farm everything while the Phase 2 banner runs. The only pacing constraint is the weekly boss.
tips.heading: Everything is farmable right now

tips.body: Dreamless Feather (×26) comes from the weekly boss Dreamless, capped at 3 claims per week. Start claiming now if you haven't — 26 drops takes about 9 weeks of full claims.
tips.heading: Weekly boss is the bottleneck

tips.body: Suncoveter's Reach (×46) drops from the Hyvatia world boss at Starward Riseway, Lahai-Roi — the same boss Lucilla needs for her ascension. If you're pulling both Phase 2 5-stars, farm this boss for both lists at once.
tips.heading: Hyvatia covers two characters

tips.body: You need 60 Rimewisps. Sweep the Lahai-Roi overworld (~40 nodes across Etching Plains and the area outside the Hyvatia arena near Starward Riseway), then buy 15 per week from the N.A.N.A. Resonator Nursing Unit for 3,000 Shell Credits each. One sweep plus one shop restock nearly covers it.
tips.heading: Rimewisp routes

tips.body: Incomplete / Aftertune / Remnant / Reverb Combustors (25 / 28 / 55 / 67) drop from the Forgery Challenge in Lahai-Roi. Run the highest difficulty available for better odds at Remnant and Reverb tiers.
tips.heading: Combustors come from Lahai-Roi forgeries

guides.banner: Version 3.8 Phase 1 — banner runs Nov 12 – Dec 3, 2026 (server time), confirmed at the Nov 6 preview broadcast
confirmed: 5-star Resonator — and the only new unit announced for Version 3.8 so far.
Attribute: Spectro — officially confirmed by Kuro Games in her Resonator Archive Preview (drip marketing, early October 2026).
Weapon: Pistols — she is the second Spectro Pistols Resonator, after Lynae.
Banner: Version 3.8, Phase 1 — she debuts on the day Version 3.8 launches.

Release date CONFIRMED: Version 3.8 launches Nov 12, 2026 (server time), announced at the Nov 6 preview broadcast. Lily’s Phase 1 banner runs Nov 12 – Dec 3, 2026, alongside Sigrika and Qiuyuan reruns.
Phase 1’s 4-star rate-ups are Youhu, Aalto and Yangyang (Game8 and Sportskeeda agree).
Her signature weapon is Lullaby (5-star Pistols) — confirmed at the Nov 6 preview broadcast; it headlines the Phase 1 weapon banner.
Kit shape, shown at the broadcast: a healer who deals AoE damage, gathers enemies while channeling her Forte, and heals the team through her Resonance Liberation.
From the Federated Cities: a young perfumer whose rare Resonance Ability made her a psychotherapist to the soldiers around her in the Resonator War (official profile).

Her echo set is already in the game: Flower of Tinged Yearning was added in Version 3.7 and can be farmed today (see below). No released Resonator can fully use it yet — it was made for a healer who also works with Unison, which is why every build outlet expects it to be Lily's set.
guides.description: Pre-farm guide for Lily (WuWa 3.8 Phase 1, Nov 12 – Dec 3, 2026): confirmed facts, Flower of Tinged Yearning echoes to farm today, and labeled beta materials.

echoFarm.farm: Heart of Stillness Tacet Field, Simulacrum Nexus (Mengzhou) · also drops from Mengzhou Tacet Discord Nests
echoFarm.name: Flower of Tinged Yearning — 5-piece
echoFarm.note: Live in-game since Version 3.7. 2-pc: Healing Bonus +10%. 5-pc: healing a Resonator raises the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 10% for 30s (effects of the same name cannot stack); while that buff is active, gaining Unison or triggering Unison Response adds a further +15% ATK. The 1-cost pieces to look for are the four Flower puppets: Fright, Grief, Reflection and Anger. Beta build coverage (two outlets) points to Healing Bonus on the 4-cost, Energy Regen on both 3-costs and HP% on both 1-costs, aiming for roughly 260% Energy Regen in total — and post-broadcast build coverage confirms that stat direction. Farm the pieces now; the final kit numbers lock at launch on Nov 12.

echoFarm.farm: Already in the game since Version 1.0 — check the pieces your Shorekeeper or Verina already wears before farming anything new
echoFarm.name: Rejuvenating Glow — 5-piece (the safe fallback)
echoFarm.note: The long-standing healer set: healing raises the whole team's ATK, no Unison needed. If Flower's Unison bonus does not fit the team you actually run, a good Rejuvenating Glow set you already own is the plan B. Every build outlet expects Flower to be Lily's set; Glow is here so you are covered either way on day one.

pending: Official material names — beta leaks name Exoswarm Cores, the Combustor family, Suncoveter's Reach (boss drop) and Gold in Memory (weekly boss), but Kuro has not published Lily's list. Treat the leaked names as a head start, not as fact, until the official list publishes at launch on Nov 12.
Her local specialty's name — every source so far just says 'a local specialty ×60'. It is likely a new item added in Version 3.8, so it probably cannot be farmed early at all.

Final kit numbers — the Nov 6 broadcast showed her kit (off-field healer and team buffer who scales on Max HP and supports Unison teams), but the final numbers, sequences and wording only lock when 3.8 goes live on Nov 12; beta figures can still differ.
Main echo follows the set — Fallacy of No Return with Rejuvenating Glow, Formrender with Flower of Tinged Yearning (post-broadcast build coverage).

tips.body: The set is already in the game (added in 3.7), so this is real pre-farming, not speculation about a future drop. Run the Heart of Stillness Tacet Field in the Simulacrum Nexus (reached through the Chapter IV Act IV main story), or sweep the Mengzhou Tacet Discord Nests — Game8 notes up to 90 nest echoes a day without spending Waveplates, though nests share drops with Mengzhou's other Sonata sets. Keep any piece with HP% or Energy Regen rolls; her healing is expected to scale on health, and both stats are safe keeps today.
tips.heading: Farm Flower of Tinged Yearning now — it's live today

tips.body: This is the one section built on beta leaks, so read it with that label on: a leaked material list (sportskeeda, via beta leaks) and a second guide's checklist (mone.gg) agree on every total — ascension: enemy cores 4 / 12 / 12 / 4, boss drop ×46, local specialty ×60, 170,000 Shell Credits; full forte tree: cores 25 / 28 / 40 / 57, skill materials 25 / 28 / 55 / 67, weekly-boss drop ×26, 2,030,000 Shell Credits. The leaked names are Exoswarm Cores (from Exoswarm enemies in Lahai-Roi), the Combustor family (Embers Forgery Challenge, Lahai-Roi — the Pistols skill material), Suncoveter's Reach (boss drop from Hyvatia in the Roya Frostlands) and Gold in Memory (weekly boss Sigillum, Lahai-Roi). One comfort if you farm them early: those are exactly Lynae's material families too, so a stockpile is not wasted even if Lily's list shifts at the broadcast. The local specialty has no leaked name and is likely new in 3.8 — that one probably cannot be farmed until launch day.
tips.heading: Her materials, from beta coverage — useful, not official

tips.body: Credits are universal, so a stockpile is never wasted. The two material guides above agree on 170,000 Shell Credits for ascension plus 2,030,000 for the full forte tree — about 2.2M before weapons and echoes, the same totals Suoming, Lynae and Lucilla each needed. Treat it as the planning target for Lily too; it is the safest number on this page.
tips.heading: Bank about 2.2M Shell Credits

tips.body: Beta build coverage (gurugamer and u7buy) tells one consistent story: her damage finishers turn extra Energy Regen into Crit Rate and Crit DMG, so the target is roughly 260% Energy Regen, reached with Energy Regen on both 3-cost echoes. The expected layout is Healing Bonus on the 4-cost, Energy Regen on the 3-costs and HP% on the 1-costs, with Energy Regen and HP% as the substats that matter — plain ATK and Crit rolls do little for her. The Nov 6 broadcast backed this direction; the final numbers lock at launch on Nov 12, so farm and keep the pieces now.
tips.heading: Echo stats: health and energy first (beta advice)

tips.body: Think of Lily as the healer seat — the spot Shorekeeper fills in most teams today. The team two outlets sketch for her: Hsin as the main damage dealer, Suoming feeding the team's Unison energy, and Lily keeping both alive while her buffs stack every time Unison triggers — that loop is exactly what her echo set rewards. No Suoming? One build guide swaps Jinhsi in next to Hsin instead. She is also expected to suit Echo Skill damage dealers like Sigrika, because her buffs raise Echo Skill Crit (two outlets). The kit aired on Nov 6 and matches this sketch; exact team rankings settle once she is playable on Nov 12.
tips.heading: Her first team, sketched

tips.body: The Nov 6 broadcast confirmed her kit’s shape, her signature weapon Lullaby, and the Nov 12 launch with Sigrika and Qiuyuan beside her in Phase 1. Still not official: her material names (Kuro has not published the list) and the final kit numbers, which lock at launch. Until then: echoes and Shell Credits are the confirmed spends, and the leaked materials stay a calculated head start.
tips.heading: The broadcast has aired — what is still pending
